description: This file contains type annotations, class and function definitions for Dynamo evaluation frames and related utilities in PyTorch, including handling of code objects, guard management, and frame execution strategies.

classes.name: _CacheEntry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry for compiled code with guard and backend management.

classes.name: _ExtraState
classes.description: Provides methods to invalidate cache entries.

classes.name: _FrameAction
classes.description: Enumeration for frame actions: default, skip, run only.

classes.name: _FrameExecStrategy
classes.description: Defines execution strategies for frames, including current and recursive actions.

classes.name: _PyInterpreterFrame
classes.description: Encapsulates a Python interpreter frame with relevant properties.

methods.name: set_eval_frame
methods.description: Sets a callback to evaluate frames.

methods.name: set_skip_guard_eval_unsafe
methods.description: Sets whether to unsafe skip guard evaluation.

methods.name: get_eval_frame_callback
methods.description: Retrieves the current eval frame callback.

methods.name: set_code_exec_strategy
methods.description: Sets the execution strategy for code objects.

methods.name: set_guard_error_hook
methods.description: Sets a hook for guard errors.

methods.name: set_guard_complete_hook
methods.description: Sets a hook for guard completion.

methods.name: get_c_recursion_limit
methods.description: Gets the current C recursion limit.
